listeningQuestions.audio: Zhang Yue is the chairwoman of a company that grows roses in a quiet valley.
opts: 张悦是一家在静谧山谷里种玫瑰的公司的女会长。
张悦从未经营过任何公司。
她的公司只生产化妆品。

listeningQuestions.audio: The workers pick the delicate flowers before sunrise every morning.
opts: 工人们每天清晨在日出前采摘娇嫩的花朵。
花朵是机器自动采摘的。

listeningQuestions.audio: A large company offered to purchase her product and help with its distribution.
opts: 一家大公司提出购买她的产品并帮忙分销。
没有公司愿意买她的产品。
她拒绝把产品卖给任何人。

listeningQuestions.audio: This year she can pay every worker a fair bonus.
opts: 今年她能给每位工人发一笔公道的奖金。
今年公司付不出任何工资。

listeningQuestions.audio: The sharing economy lets people borrow things instead of buying them.
opts: 共享经济让人们借用物品而非购买。
共享经济迫使人们买更多东西。

listeningQuestions.audio: Always pay your bill on time, or your credit score will fall.
opts: 务必按时还款,否则你的信用分会下降。
信用分和还款毫无关系。

quizQuestions.q: She is now the ____ of her own rose company.(女会长)
This year every worker received a ____ as a reward.(奖金)
Only after returning home did she see the ____ of roses.(潜力)
A part-time job should never ____ with your studies.(妨碍)
This is the valley ____ roses grow wild all year round.
The entrepreneur ____ started the rose farm is now famous.
She decided to grow roses, ____ surprised many people.
I will never forget the day ____ I started my own business.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 起步阶段最大的挑战是说服当地人为她工作。
她一开始就有很多顾客。
村民们立刻就相信了她。
quizQuestions.audio: The biggest challenge at the early phase was to persuade local people to work for her.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 用手机你可以租一辆自行车或租一个房间。
手机不能用来支付任何费用。
共享只适合公司,不适合个人。
quizQuestions.audio: With a phone, you can hire a bike for an hour or rent a room for a night.

reading.passage: Zhang Yue once paid little attention to the roses around her home. After studying overseas, she saw their business potential, returned home, and built a flower company whose roses are now sold across Asia.
reading.passageCn: 张悦曾对家乡四周的玫瑰不以为意。出国留学后,她看到了它们的商业潜力,于是回乡创办了一家花卉公司,如今其玫瑰已销往亚洲各地。

questions.q: When did Zhang Yue notice the value of the roses?
opts: When she was a small child.
Before she left her home town.

questions.q: How well does her company do now?
opts: Its roses are sold across Asia.
It sells only in one village.
It grows no roses at all.

writing.prompt: Write a few sentences to introduce a local product you like. Say what it is and where it comes from, describe one special feature, and explain why you recommend it. Try to use attributive clauses (which / who / where / whose).
writing.promptCn: 写几句话介绍一款你喜欢的本地产品:说明它是什么、产自哪里,描述一个特别之处,并解释为什么推荐它。尝试使用定语从句(which / who / where / whose)。

lines.text: Have you heard of the woman who grows roses in that quiet valley?
lines.cn: 你听说过那个在静谧山谷里种玫瑰的女人吗?

lines.text: Yes, the chairwoman whose roses are now sold across Asia. She's amazing.
lines.cn: 听过,就是那位玫瑰已卖到亚洲各地的女会长。她太厉害了。

lines.text: The hardest part was the early phase, when few people believed in her.
lines.cn: 最难的是起步阶段,那时很少有人相信她。

lines.text: But she never gave up, which is why she succeeded in the end.
lines.cn: 但她从不放弃,这正是她最终成功的原因。

lines.text: University is the first place where I have to handle money on my own.
lines.cn: 大学是我第一次要自己管钱的地方。

lines.text: Then open an account that has no fees, and save a little each week.
lines.cn: 那就开一个免手续费的账户,每周存一点。

lines.text: What about a credit card, which my friend says is risky?
lines.cn: 信用卡呢?我朋友说那东西有风险。

lines.text: Use it carefully and pay on time, so you never go into debt.
lines.cn: 小心使用、按时还款,这样你就不会负债。
